verdict.rationale: Carta's API platform exposes extensive read/write endpoints for cap tables, stakeholders, option grants, convertible notes, FMV, and even MCP-based natural-language access, suggesting broad API coverage of core data. However there's no documentation claiming full UI/API parity, no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (probes 404), and many UI workflows (e.g., board approvals, secondary transactions, cancellation/subscription management) show no API equivalent in evidence. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, coverage of admin/workflow actions beyond data retrieval.
